name: hedera-smart-order-router
description: Hedera Smart Order Router: quote SaucerSwap V1, V2, the V3 order book and Lambdaplex, split across AMM pools, execute on the best venue, publish an HCS best-execution receipt and verify it from the mirror node.

envVars.description: ECDSA private key (0x-hex) of the funded testnet account that deploys RouterExecutor and seeds liquidity. Server-only.
Hedera account ID (0.0.x) used by the server to create the HCS topic and submit receipts. Server-only.
Private key for HEDERA_OPERATOR_ID (ECDSA or ED25519, DER or hex). Server-only.
EVM address of the deployed RouterExecutor contract on the target network. Public.
HCS topic ID (0.0.x) that best-execution receipts are published to. Public.
Hedera account ID of the bot that authenticates to the SaucerSwap V3 Orderbook API and signs orders server-side. Server-only, optional.
Private key for V3_BOT_ACCOUNT_ID (ECDSA or ED25519). Server-only, optional.
ED25519 when V3_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY is a raw-hex ED25519 key (ECDSA hex and DER keys are detected). Server-only, optional.
Set to true to allow any code path that moves real mainnet funds. Default false.
Per-order size cap in USD applied to mainnet execution. Default 20.
Lambdaplex X-API-KEY for keyed market data and order placement (mainnet only). Server-only, optional.
Ed25519 private seed (hex) paired with LAMBDAPLEX_API_KEY for Lambdaplex Signature V1 request signing. Server-only, optional.

steps.label: See quotes from every venue with no wallet and no env
Fund a testnet account, then deploy RouterExecutor

steps.text: Full testnet and mainnet walkthroughs, the env var table and the Hedera gotchas are in README.md.
